verdict.rationale: The first-party docs only show that Grok saves every conversation to disk automatically, plus rewind and compact features that truncate or compress context. None of this is a documented control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted. The community-reported `disable_codebase_upload` config flag and the mention of enterprise-only ZDR are unverified, adjacent upload and plan controls, not a documented retention or deletion capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
